title: Fitts's Law
summary: Fitts predicts target acquisition time increases with distance and decreases as target size increases; treat as heuristic, not WCAG criterion (see RSP-005 for target sizes).

MUST.text: Make frequent/critical controls easy to acquire and near task context.

SHOULD.text: Separate adjacent targets and consider pointer/touch precision.

AVOID.text: Do not use Fitts to excuse WCAG target-size failure; meet RSP-005 (at least 24×24 CSS px).

EXAMPLE.good: Save button 44px hit area adjacent to edited field
EXAMPLE.bad: 16px icon with no hit area 300px from field

FAILURE_MODES: Large targets can crowd layouts and hide hierarchy; balance size with grouping.
Distance savings vanish if target is visually ambiguous; keep labels clear.
Fitts ignores cognitive choice; pair with Hick (EVAL-004) for menus.
